theorems.name: Submission.dtc_blowUp_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (x : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), IsOpen U → 0 < n → x ∈ U → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → IsIntegerMultiplicity C → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → HasMassDensity T x θ → MassMeasuresConverge (fun j => blowUp T x (lams j) (hlams j).ne') C → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → C.massOn (ball 0 ρ) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) * ENNReal.ofReal θ) ∧ HasMassDensity C 0 θ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
